Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 7

“One disciplined in yoga, pure in self, master of self and senses, whose self has become the self of all beings, is not tainted even while acting.”

The phrase in the middle is the remarkable one — becoming the self of all beings. Krishna makes universality, not withdrawal, the thing that keeps action from staining.
